RETIRED as a duplicate AND a mislabel. lexicalResources.datasets already carries the concept count, and ASJP uses its OWN 100-item list (*I, *you, *we, this, that, who ...) -- not a Swadesh list. Naming it Swadesh would attribute a wordlist tradition ASJP does not claim.

MERGED. nativeName (Wikidata P1705) and endonym (LinguaMeta) were the same concept as two fields with two sources -- exactly the defect the one-concept-one-field rule exists to prevent. Now one attributed field carrying both, so a reader sees every native name with its source rather than whichever field happened to be populated.

RETIRED on measurement, not preference. Resolving a MED id to a TITLE means looking it up across Glottolog's 43 bibliography files, and the numeric key space is NOT unique across them: 80,569 duplicate keys. A lookup would frequently attach the WRONG title to a language. Only 1,214 of 7,276 med ids (16.7%) resolve at all. medLevel already carries the useful fact (grammar, grammar sketch, wordlist) and medSourceId is followable by anyone who wants the title from Glottolog directly -- a citation you can follow beats a title that might be someone else's book.
